[[File:Jeff Anderson PDS2.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Jeff Anderson on PDS2. Still: Bill Bisco.]]
'''Jeff Anderson''' (GEMP handle '''Fred30117''')<ref name="retro-gempc-86781">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86781 Player List for 2026 Retro GEMPC], forum.starwarsccg.org (14 June 2026). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/Player_List_for_2026_Retro_GEMPC_forum_t86781 Internet Archive]. [[:File:SWCCG forum t86781 Player List for 2026 Retro GEMPC.txt]]</ref> finished '''#22''' at the [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]] (Dark: SYCFA; Light: Hidden Base).<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026/ 2026-09 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)], starwarsccg.org (published 10 September 2026). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/2026_Retro_GEMPC_starwarsccg_org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
He played Day 1 of the [[2000 Decipher World Championship]] and finished 86th.<ref name="pds2-anderson">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qErV_KgLAgA SWCCG PDS2: Jeff Anderson Interview], BillBisco2 (9 August 2025). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261016010143/https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qErV_KgLAgA Internet Archive].</ref>
